saw_lines: Tech buyers know the exact model they want, so they pick the seller whose price and trust check out first.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where price and proof either show up or go missing.
Your site shows 18,022 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so print 18,022 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 18,022 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust the price. Print 18,022 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote in line one.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 13 ads mention it, so first buyers get no reason to act. Put it in line one of three new ads and on the creative.
The same copy runs in 4 of 13 ads, so the same words repeat across the account. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and creative in each one so every version reads new.

4 of 13 copy ads open on the same unbeatable price and next-day delivery line, so one opener leads the account. Test two new angles against it, the first order discount and a customer review quote, in line one.
